tips_en: Recommend starting with Paper 1 for its compelling mechanistic insight into how MLLMs internally encode spatial coordinates—foundational understanding that grounds the more applied work. Papers 2 and 3 are tightly connected, both probing agent capabilities on complex multi-stage tasks: Paper 2 demonstrates dramatic gains in terminal agents through better trajectory data (+14.2%), while Paper 3 exposes systematic failure modes (overfitting, hollow runtimes) in coding agents that build other agents, highlighting that better training data alone is insufficient without rigorous benchmarking.
tips_zh: 建议从论文1开始阅读，它深入揭示了多模态大语言模型如何在内部编码空间坐标——这种基础性理解能更好地支撑后续偏应用的工作。论文2和论文3紧密相关，都聚焦智能体在复杂多阶段任务中的能力：论文2通过更优质的轨迹数据显著提升终端智能体表现（+14.2%），而论文3则暴露了构建智能体的代码智能体中系统性的失败模式（过拟合、空壳运行），凸显仅有更好的训练数据仍不够，仍需严格的基准测试加以保障。
